headline.purpose: One page heading per screen; 1.875rem from md.

body.purpose: Rows, descriptions, form copy; inputs 1rem below 768px.

label.purpose: Field labels, chip and segmented text, buttons at 0.8125rem.

caps.purpose: Product line under the wordmark and in-panel section labels; never above a page heading.

mono.purpose: Machine data only: codes, times, counts, phone numbers.

shadows.name: neu-raised
shadows.purpose: Cards, panels, navigation bars, auth sheet, big SOS dish. Tightens to 7px 7px 16px / -7px -7px 16px below 768px.

shadows.name: neu-raised-sm
shadows.purpose: Small tiles, convex controls, map zoom control, hover of raised-xs controls. Also aliased as --card-shadow.

shadows.name: neu-raised-xs
shadows.purpose: Ghost buttons, segmented track, unchosen choice tiles, tooltips.

shadows.name: neu-inset-sm
shadows.purpose: Every pressed state (chosen segment, chosen tile, active nav, selected queue row, :active buttons), text fields, value wells, rail SOS dish.

shadows.name: accent-lift
shadows.purpose: Primary and auth buttons only. Dark: 6px 6px 14px rgb(8 11 18 / 0.6), -4px -4px 10px var(--neu-light).

shadows.name: accent-pressed
shadows.purpose: Primary and auth buttons on :active (replaces the lift).

shadows.name: sos-sphere
shadows.purpose: SOS button only; idle pulse widens the drop to 34px and adds a 0 0 0 7px rgb(236 59 82 / 0.1) halo. Rail size: still 2px 3px 6px lift.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Focused text field, with a 55% Signal Blue border.

motion.name: ease-smooth-out
motion.purpose: Hover lift, segmented and nav state, page enter, activity timeline.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Button press, field focus, SOS press, pulses.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover lift, segmented option, nav active, theme switch colour fade.

motion.name: page-transition
motion.purpose: View Transitions cross-fade with a 10px rise; chrome stays still.

motion.name: activity-reveal
motion.purpose: The dashboard's one authored motion moment.

motion.name: sos-pulse
motion.purpose: Idle SOS glow (hero and tab bar sizes only).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animations and transitions collapse to 0.01ms; timeline shows final state; skeleton sweep removed.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.note: tab bar becomes rail; inputs drop to 0.875rem; raised shadow widens

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.note: admin sidebar docks; auth goes two-column

breakpoints.name: 2xl
breakpoints.note: student rail expands to 240px with labels

themes.anon: html.anon rebinds the accent family to violet in both themes

legacyAliases.--auth-hero: still defined in .auth-shell; no longer paints the phone header

narrative.overview:
CampusSafe is a safety loop for one campus, used by a scared student on a phone, a command operator at a desk and a responder in the field. The visual world is soft UI cut from a single material: the page is a quiet soft-blue surface, and every panel, bar and control is that same surface pushed up or pressed in. Nothing floats on top of anything else. Shape comes only from a pair of shadows, a cool one to the bottom-right and a light one to the top-left, as if lit from the top-left corner. The world deliberately refuses the earlier frosted-glass look: no translucency, no backdrop blur, no aurora of colour behind the panels.

The material carries meaning. Raised means available: a card you can open, a button you can press, a tile you can pick. Pressed means chosen or typed into: the selected filter, the active nav item, the chosen category, every text field. Colour then does semantic work on top of that grammar: the one blue is "act", red is SOS and P1, violet is anonymity, and green, amber and orange carry status and severity. The calm, low-contrast surface is what lets the red SOS sphere read as the single loud thing on screen.

Density varies by role: the student app is roomy and phone-first with the SOS dish riding up out of the tab bar; the admin console is a dense grid of raised cards inside a raised sidebar and top bar; the responder app sits between. Light is the default theme and dark is a full peer (`data-theme="dark"`): the same shapes cut from a deep slate-blue (`#252c38`), lit by a faint blue-grey highlight instead of white.
keyCharacteristics: One material: every surface is the page colour, shaped only by a top-left light and bottom-right shadow.
Raised = available, pressed = chosen or typed into.
One blue convex fill with white text for the primary action; red SOS sphere in a raised dish; violet for anonymity.
Manrope headings, Inter body, JetBrains Mono only for machine data.
Severity and kind carried by tinted pill chips with text labels, never colour alone.
One authored motion moment per surface; everything else is a short exponential ease-out.

rules.name: The Dim Floor Rule
rules.body: `dim` is the lightest text colour in the system and it passes WCAG AA for small text on the surface (4.7:1 on `#e4ecf7` in light, 5.4:1 on `#252c38` in dark). Do not introduce a lighter grey for text.

rules.name: The White-On-Blue Rule
rules.body: Text on the blue accent fill is `on-accent` white in both themes, never ink.

rules.name: The Anonymous Flip Rule
rules.body: Anonymity is shown by swapping the accent, not by adding a new one: `html.anon` rebinds neon, accent, accent-fill, accent-lift, neon-dim, neon-glow and map-pin to violet, and every component follows.

rules.name: The Violet Is Anonymity Rule
rules.body: Violet means "identity withheld". Charts, gradients and decoration do not borrow it; outside the anonymous flow it appears only on anonymous data and the under-review status.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: Page headings stand alone. Do not put an eyebrow or kicker label above an `h1` or `h2`; context goes in a line below the heading (for example "Live · updated 3s ago").

rules.name: The Mono Means Machine Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is for values a system produced (codes, times, counts, IDs), never for prose or headings.

rules.name: The One Material Rule
rules.body: Every panel, bar and control is cut from the page surface and shaped only by the light/shadow pair. Do not combine a border or ring with a soft shadow on the same element, and give each control exactly one elevation cue: raised, pressed, or (for the primary) the blue lift.

rules.name: The Pressed Means Chosen Rule
rules.body: Selection is shown by sinking, not by outlining or inverting. A control that is chosen, active or typed into takes the inset shadow; everything available stays raised. Never use the inset state for "suggested" or "hovered".

rules.name: The Glow Is Earned Rule
rules.body: Coloured light belongs only to the primary blue lift and the SOS sphere. Cards, chips, rows, chart marks and legend dots never glow.

rules.name: The Pin Rule
rules.body: On any map, only SOS is red. Non-SOS pins use `--map-pin` (the accent in light, `#8db2ff` in dark, violet in the anonymous flow), which must never drift toward red or orange.

dos: **Do** build every panel from the one material: surface fill, 24px corners, the Raised shadow; every navigation bar the same, at 22px or 28px.
**Do** show "chosen", "active" and "typed into" by pressing the control in (inset small), and keep everything available raised.
**Do** keep the primary action the only blue convex fill on a surface, with white text and the accent lift.
**Do** carry severity and kind with tinted pill chips, always with a text label (P1, SOS, ANON, Resolved), never colour alone.
**Do** rely on the global keyboard focus ring (2px Signal Blue outline, 2px offset), the neon-dim selection tint and the Signal Blue caret.

**Do** give each surface at most one authored motion moment (the activity feed's draw-down on the dashboard), using exponential ease-out (`cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)` or `cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)`), with a reduced-motion fallback that shows the final state.
**Do** keep Dim Slate as the lightest text colour, and check any text on a solid status fill clears 4.5:1 in both themes.
**Do** redefine any new token for dark under `:root[data-theme="dark"]` and, if it is accent-coloured, for `html.anon`.
donts: **Don't** reintroduce translucent glass, backdrop blur or a coloured aurora behind panels.
**Don't** put a border or ring and a soft shadow on the same element, or stack two elevation cues on one control.
**Don't** mark a selection by outlining, inverting to a dark fill, or tinting; sink it.
**Don't** let anything glow except the primary blue lift and the SOS sphere.
**Don't** put eyebrow or kicker labels above page headings.
**Don't** use violet for decoration, chart gradients or categorical series; it means anonymity.
**Don't** use coloured side stripes (left-border accents) on list rows or cards to show severity or status; use chips.
**Don't** animate continuously anything that is not live state.
**Don't** use a grey lighter than Dim Slate for any text, including placeholders.
